# ANALYSIS: OOS_TEST_2025Q3_2026Q1_REALFILLS_TOP3J

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** quality_gate
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that the current engine's performance on J's anchor days can be validated and improved by ensuring robustness across out-of-sample periods (2025-Q3 and 2026-Q1) and confirming that real OPRA fills on the top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) match simulated expectations within ±20%.

## Mechanism

We will run the existing engine (or a candidate under evaluation) through a walk-forward OOS test on 2025-Q3 and 2026-Q1, computing edge_capture and aggregate Sharpe. Additionally, we will replay the top 3 J days using a realistic OPRA fill simulator (including bid-ask slippage) and compare P&L to the BS-sim baseline. If the OOS edge_capture remains above the 771 floor and real-fills diff is <20%, we consider the candidate robust.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline.
2. **Sample bias:** Sample size = 2 quarters (2025-Q3, 2026-Q1) selected as chronological hold-out windows; overfit risk mitigated by walk-forward and real-fills validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window to be performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real OPRA fill check on top 3 J days to be performed).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: large gap against position causing premium stop to trigger at worse-than-simulated price; max drawdown scenario if OOS window contains adverse regime; blow-up if liquidity dries and slippage exceeds risk caps.
6. **Concentration:** Will be measured post-test; if top-5 days exceed 60% of P&L, will be disclosed.

## Pre-merge gate

- OOS test on 2025-Q3 and 2026-Q1 must show edge_capture >= 771 (50% of max 1542) and aggregate Sharpe >= 0.5.
- Walk-forward OOS/IS Sharpe ratio >= 0.70.
- Real-fills check on top 3 J days: simulated vs real P&L diff < ±20% for each day.
- Anchor no-regression: edge_capture on J days must not decrease relative to baseline engine.
